_comment: Row 753 clause 3. The run record has to carry the exact command and what the run DID, and an unmeasurable run has to be UNKNOWN rather than a clean one. M1 empties the recorded command, M2 lets a reporter that exposed no stats write the clean run's record, M3 stops the record from naming which tests failed, M4 is the conftest seam -- the one caller -- no longer handing the outcome to the recorder at all, M5 drops the guard that keeps pytest's un-outcomed bucket out of the counts, and M6 turns a report with no nodeid into a nameless empty string instead of UNKNOWN. Every anchor is a zero-width execution position on a decision; no value is inside any matched span. The transform control lives in row753_run_record_says_what_the_run_did_transform_control.json and MUST ESCAPE.
subject: a run's own record says what it ran on, what command started it, and what happened -- so a reproduction attempt that comes back green is distinguishable from one that never looked

mutants.label: M1 the record carries an empty command instead of the one that started the run
M2 a reporter that exposed no stats writes the record of a run in which nothing failed
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^    if not isinstance\(stats, dict\):\n)(?=        return \{"recorded": False,)
